text:
laura: hey team — quick heads up, PR #18921 is ready but blocked. needs rebase and merge, CI's hanging on mac-e2e and there's a schema lock in staging from the db migration job. wondering if we should request a small rebase window before the freeze or wait for CI queue to clear
raj: thanks for the ping. is the schema lock blocking deploys or just tests?
laura: it's the migration job holding the lock; tests that apply migrations are queued. deploys are fine but we can't merge a migration without the lock being released
cheng: db-migration job 1432 holds the lock atm, looks like it hit a timeout on smoke tests
ci-bot: Job 1432 failed at step `apply-migrations` — timeout. See https://ci.example/redwood/jobs/1432
sam: short window idea: we could aim for 03:30 UTC tomorrow to rebase+merge, but that's really close to the 04:00 UTC deploy freeze — risky if anything flakes
laura: alternative is to ask mira to release the lock briefly or re-run job 1432 to free the queue. @mira can you advise?
mira: I can try a manual unlock and rerun, but want to avoid partial migrations. I'll rerun 1432 in ~10m and monitor
laura: thanks. FYI my local rebase script fails on mac matrix: ```./scripts/rebase-and-verify.sh pr/18921``` — mac-e2e is flaky and blocks the last gate
cheng: to bypass mac queue for the retry you can run `CI_LABEL=linux ./ci/run e2e` which uses the linux runner (not ideal for final gates but helpful to unblock integration checks)
laura: kicked off a linux-only rerun, CI rerun id 1433 started at 1744406900
ci-bot: Rerun 1433 started — unit and integration jobs in progress
laura: update: 1433 passed unit+integration but mac-e2e still queued behind several jobs
raj: if mac stays queued, i'm +1 for the 03:30 rebase window with strict canary and abort-on-failure. we should notify infra and product about potential rollback if migration partially applies
sam: agree with raj. also add a short rollback checklist in the merge PR (DB revert + feature flag off)
laura: will add rollback steps and file the merge-window request in #eng-releases. i'll ping infra for the schema unlock once mira confirms rerun status
mira: rerun finished, 1432 now passed smoke tests and released the lock at 1744406990 — queue should clear in ~5–10m
cheng: monitoring the queue, moving older mac jobs up where possible — will post status in 5
ci-bot: deploy-freeze reminder: freeze starts 04:00 UTC — merges after 03:45 UTC are not recommended(note: consider canary-only landing before freeze)
laura: perfect. plan: wait ~10m for mac queue to clear; if mac still blocked we'll request 03:30 rebase window and proceed with canary + rollback checklist. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
cheng: on it — I'll post follow-up when the mac gate is clear
laura: thanks — will update the PR and release thread shortly
